'''1999 Corellia Regionals''' was the Star Wars CCG regional championship for the Corellia region, a qualifier for the [[1999 Decipher World Championship]]. It was held in September 1999 in the Holiday Inn ballroom in Indianapolis, Indiana. Forty-nine players took part, out of 118 who had qualified through regional preliminaries, and they came from all five of the region's states. [[Chad McCory]] of Carmel, Indiana, won the two-game final against [[Joe Mornout]] and earned a place at Worlds.<ref name="nf-cor99">[http://decipher.com/newsflash/1999/0999/092799storyA.html Corellia Regional: Nowhere To Drain], Alex Alcalde, Decipher NewsFlash (27 September 1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000226090748/http://decipher.com:80/newsflash/1999/0999/092799storyA.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="cec-reg">[http://www.geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/regional.html 1999 Corellia Regional Championship], Alex Alcalde, Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (GeoCities). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000618013958/http://www.geocities.com:80/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/regional.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional championship (Corellia), World Championship qualifier
* '''Date:''' September 1999 (a Saturday; see Discrepancies)
* '''Site:''' Holiday Inn ballroom, Indianapolis, Indiana
* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Field:''' 49 players; six rounds of preliminary games, then a two-game final between the top two
* '''Directors:''' [[Alex Alcalde]] (Gold 31), with [[John Kaufeld]] (Gold 49) and [[Roger McEldowney]] (Gold 108)<ref name="cec-reg" />

Play began at 10:30 a.m., when Kaufeld started the pairings on the tournament software. After the first round [[Daniel Spaid]] led, ahead of [[Eric Olson]] and [[Joe Alread]]. Going into the third round Alread, McCory and [[Jared Lockwood]] were the only unbeaten players; McCory then beat Lockwood by 9. Mornout took the second place in the final on differential among the four players with five wins.<ref name="nf-cor99" /><ref name="cec-reg" />

== Final ==

* '''Game one:''' McCory ([[Light]], [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base]]) against Mornout ([[Dark]], CCT/Manipulator). The two had already met that day. McCory flipped his objective, freed Wedge at the Cloud City: Security Tower and won by 16.<ref name="cec-reg" />
* '''Game two:''' McCory ([[Dark]], Death Star with Bad Feeling Have I) against Mornout ([[Light]], [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base]] with Dagobah sites). Mornout's battle with I Have A Very Bad Feeling About This drew 27 in destiny, but Come Here You Big Coward, Rebel Barrier and You Are Beaten left him with under 24 Force and nowhere to drain, and he drew up to concede.<ref name="cec-reg" />

== Statistics ==

* 49 participants, 6 drops, 7 byes, 3 timed wins, 136 games
* Light Side won 69 full and 2 timed games; Dark Side won 64 full and 1 timed
* Largest win: 45, Joe Mornout; closest win: 1, [[Blair Franklin]]<ref name="cec-reg" />

== Discrepancies ==

* '''Date:''' Alcalde's report says the event "was held this Saturday", and Decipher's NewsFlash is dated Monday 27 September 1999, which points to 25 September.<ref name="cec-reg" /><ref name="nf-cor99" /> But two reports of the [[September 1999 Anderson tournament]], dated 25 September, already call McCory the Corellia regional winner.<ref name="cec-r2">[http://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/report2.html Anderson, In (9/25/99)], Steven Horton, Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (GeoCities; OoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190202030128/http://www.oocities.org:80/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/report2.html Internet Archive]</ref> So the date is given here as September 1999.
* '''Final, game two:''' Frank Lamantia gives McCory's margin as 21; Alcalde gives none and says Mornout drew up to concede.<ref name="cec-rr1">[http://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/regionalrep1.html Corellian Regional Report No.1], Frank Lamantia, Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (GeoCities; OoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190202030113/http://www.oocities.org:80/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/regionalrep1.html Internet Archive]</ref>
